Second four-pose correction is also excluded because the contact axe fell below the soles. Third genuine replacement keeps the whole axe above both soles in all four drawings and uses actual chest-height contact. Original super drawings reordered intact to place the true axe cut at col2.
notes: All retained source drawings and their annotated rectangular import selections actually opened and checked for source costume, held equipment, full bodies and uncropped limbs. completeNative32.name: KAITO

completeNative32.sourceWork: KAITO original Japanese VOCALOID voicebank (2006), original package avatar; Cantarella vocal role (2008)

base16.sourceWork: One-Punch Man television anime season1 (2015), standard early silver-arm design
base16.characterVersion: One-Punch Man television anime season1 (2015), standard early silver-arm design
base16.sourceAppearance: Adult cyborg with short blond hair, dark eye sclera and gold irises, black sleeveless shirt, silver mechanical arms/shoulders and black trousers with heavy boots
base16.sourceWeapon: Mechanical palm incineration cannons
base16.sourcePose: Brace one actual cyborg palm, charge without a premature beam, release warm incineration from the physical palm col2, then lower the arm
base16.abilityName: Frappe du bras cybernétique de Genos

base16.name: The Oracle

base16.sourceWeapon: No weapon; a small cookie may be held as the kitchen consultation prop, never thrown as an attack
base16.sourcePose: Listen, offer a quiet spoken observation, and extend a small cookie as a reassuring consultation gesture; bounded ally advice only, no physical prophecy, telekinesis, healing or magic projectile
